in_marathi.name: Gautamshri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, Auspicious, Divine
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gautamshri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gautamshri is a Sanskrit name derived from the name Gautama. It is a combination of the words 'Gautama' and 'shri'. Gautama is the name of the sage Vyasa, who is believed to have compiled the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Gita. The suffix 'shri' is a term of respect and denotes wealth, prosperity, and divinity. Thus, Gautamshri is a name that signifies wisdom, auspiciousness, and divine blessings.
